note: These estimates describe forces available at Plassey, not the number that actually entered combat. The Company force included Indian sepoys and Europeans. The Nawab’s army included cavalry under Mir Jafar who refused to fight. The animation does not reconstruct that deployment or defection. The Nawab’s losses are given only as more than 500 and cannot supply an exact loss proportion. The sepoy model represents the majority Indian infantry contingent, while the actual Company army also contained European soldiers.
